```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"In local platform hearings, Americans discussed the importance of energy to the economy, national security, and the health of the planet.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Americans stated that the United States needs a new bold and sustainable energy policy to meet current challenges.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States has responded to new threats to national security and new competitive conditions with action in the past.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The energy threat the United States faces today is as real and as dangerous as threats from dictators.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The opportunities that would come with change in energy policy are greater than the dangers.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Jobs of the 21st Century will be created in developing new energy solutions.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The question is whether these jobs will be created in the United States or abroad.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States should use government procurement policies to incentivize domestic production of clean and renewable energy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Countries like Germany, Spain and Brazil have benefited from economic growth from clean energy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States is decades behind in confronting this energy challenge.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```

```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"In the local platform hearings, Americans talked about the importance of energy to the economy, to national security, and to the health of our planet.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Americans said that America needs a new bold and sustainable energy policy to meet the challenges of our time.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In the past, America has been stirred to action when faced with new threats to national security, or new competitive conditions that undercut economic leadership.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The energy threat the United States faces today may be less immediate than threats from dictators, but it is as real and as dangerous.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The dangers of the energy threat are eclipsed only by the opportunities that would come with change.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Jobs of the 21st Century will be created in developing new energy solutions.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The question is whether these jobs will be created in America, or abroad.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States should use government procurement policies to incentivize domestic production of clean and renewable energy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Countries like Germany, Spain and Brazil have reaped the benefits of economic growth from clean energy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States is decades behind in confronting this challenge.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
